messages.subject: Sustainability Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Responsible Growth Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Kruczkowska,

LevelUP Sustainability Recruiting's focus on sustainability and impact leadership makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where sustainability strategy, stakeholder confidence, regulatory credibility and responsible growth must be managed together. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for broader global opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches across ESG, sustainability, responsible business, external affairs and stakeholder leadership.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
